observations.title: Web mid-edit 401 keeps the target but clears the unsent introduction
steps: Web A signed in, opens M4 apply editor and types an introduction without sending. A second tab signs out normally (session shared by host name; drafts live in per-tab sessionStorage so the second tab cannot clear them).

Original tab clicks Send → POST applications 401 → sign-in page with returnTo=/meals/M4/apply. After normal OTP the apply page returns but the introduction is empty (0/300). DB: no application created (no automatic replay).
Source: session 401 path calls clearAllPrivateState(), deleting drafts; contract §100/§102 and J008 expect the draft and target kept on 401 (QA-F62).
